title: Indiana Hoosier Sugar Cream Pie (Crustless Ramekin Option)
originalTitle: Indiana Hoosier Sugar Cream Pie (Crustless Ramekin Option)
ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar (or half white, half light brown sugar)
1/2 tsp freshly grated nutmeg + cinnamon for dusting
Optional: 1 par-baked 9-inch pie crust (or bake crustless in buttered ramekins)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly butter 4–6 individual ramekins (for the crustless version) or prepare a par-baked pie shell.
In a medium saucepan, whisk together sugar, cornstarch, and salt. Slowly whisk in heavy cream and whole milk until completely smooth.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, for 6–8 minutes until the custard bubbles and thickens to a pudding consistency.
Remove from heat, whisk in the butter and vanilla extract, pour into ramekins (or pie crust), dust generously with nutmeg and cinnamon, and bake 20–25 minutes until trembling and golden.
notes: Personal Note: Can use crustless in a ramekin!
